definitions.explanation: A situation or action that must be accepted because there is no alternative.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦やむを{得|え}ず→やむを得ず：08528_yamuwoezu⟧⟦{欠席|けっせき}した→欠席する：22283_kessekisuru⟧。
examples.english: Due to circumstances, I had no choice but to be absent.

examples.japanese: やむを{得|え}ない⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}して→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please contact us if there are unavoidable circumstances.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧やむを{得|え}ない。
examples.english: Under these circumstances, postponement is unavoidable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やむを{得|え}ず→やむを得ず：08528_yamuwoezu⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}した→中止する：21909_chuushisuru⟧。
examples.english: For safety reasons, the construction was unavoidably halted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やむを{得|え}ない⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{届|とど}け{出|で}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}せば→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められる→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: If the person has unavoidable circumstances, absences are permitted upon submitting a notification.

notes:
FORMS:
やむ (to cease, stop) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ (object particle) + ⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧ (cannot obtain) → cannot make it stop = unavoidable
- やむを{得|え}ない⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧ - unavoidable circumstances
- ⟦やむを{得|え}ず→やむを得ず：08528_yamuwoezu⟧ (adverb) - unavoidably, having no choice
- やむを{得|え}ない⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧ - when unavoidable

COMMON PATTERNS:
This is a set expression. やむ is the classical verb meaning "to cease" and ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧ is the negative potential form of ⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to obtain).

USAGE:
Common in formal and business contexts as an explanation or justification. Often used in written notices and announcements.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - can't be helped (more casual)
- {致|いた}し⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - unavoidable (formal)
